/family/scan.reason: Client-only form (components-next/family-scan-client.tsx has no fetch): it extracts the invite code from a pasted code or link and navigates to /family/join?code=, which is the screen that calls the API. The copy mentions a QR scan but there is no camera; the page text itself says to paste.

/health/actionable-order.reason: Renders orders from a JSON `payload` query string parsed on the server, no backend call. Nothing in patient-web links to it (grep for the route finds only the page); the app version reads a payload "pushed from the consultation end". An orphan route fed by a client-built query string, not by consultation data.

/health/wearables.reason: Feature-flagged: notFound() unless NEXT_PUBLIC_WEARABLES_ENABLED is true (F20, hidden until a real HealthKit / Health Connect integration). When shown it is two links (log a reading, vitals history); the data lives on those pages.

/maternity/baby-growth.reason: The page promises weekly content linked to the maternity profile but fetches nothing and shows none, only a link to the tracker. Its sibling /maternity/baby-development redirects with the comment "curated content pending clinical review", and the backend GET /maternity/content returns empty arrays by design; no client calls that endpoint.

/maternity/ovulation.reason: Pointer page to /maternity/tracker (which calls GET /maternity/profile). Its intro says estimates are computed locally and labelled as estimates, but this page computes and shows none; the copy describes the tracker, not this page.

/mental-health/self-assessment.reason: Awareness copy plus links to mood, consultations and crisis contacts; no questionnaire by design: the app route redirects to the hub ("diagnostic-style self-assessments are intentionally unavailable until a clinically governed workflow is approved") although the backend serves GET /mental-health/assessment-questions.

/mental-health/therapist-match.reason: Pointer to the doctors directory (/consultations/doctors) with a sentence telling the user to pick a specialty there. No matching is done on the page, despite the title.

/onboarding.reason: Three intro slides defined in the page (title, body, icon from SERVICE_ICONS), carousel in components-next/onboarding-carousel.tsx with links only. Onboarding copy, no data.

/onboarding/language.reason: Language list from lib/i18n (locales, localeLabels) as links to the same page in another locale, then a link to /onboarding/permissions.

/onboarding/permissions.reason: components-next/onboarding-permissions-client.tsx asks the browser for geolocation and Notification permission; no API call and nothing is stored.

/provider-info.reason: Public information page (join as a provider via the provider app) with two links; no data.

/settings/about.reason: About copy and four team cards defined in the page (TEAMS constant), links to terms and privacy. Static by design; the cards carry no numbers.

/settings/help.reason: Four curated topic links (appointments, pharmacy, insurance, returns) plus support and feedback links; all six target routes exist in patient-web/app.

/settings/language.reason: components-next/locale-selector.tsx switches the locale in the URL; saved on the device only, as the page says. No backend field.

/voice.reason: Launcher: seven links defined in the page plus components-next/voice-command-button.tsx, which uses the browser SpeechRecognition API and navigates by keyword; no API call.
